note: Used two wheelers, used tools and biking related goods from the local and used market. Everything here was inspected in person or is shown as a demo listing. Frontier Moto holds no stock yet and brokers no sales. Notes on condition, not offers. Nothing transacts yet.

gear.name: Full face helmet, vented
gear.summary: Ventilation matters more than weight at equatorial midday. A quiet helmet that cooks you is the wrong helmet.

gear.name: Two piece rain suit over armour
gear.summary: Survives a full season if the seams are taped and it goes over armour rather than under it. Packs smaller than a one piece.

gear.name: Dry bag with compression straps
gear.summary: Cheaper, lighter and more waterproof than hard cases, and it does not change the width of the bike in traffic.

gear.name: Dual purpose, road biased
gear.summary: For riders who meet murram occasionally rather than daily. A knobbly tyre used mostly on tarmac is a braking problem.

gear.name: Tyre plug kit and compact inflator
gear.summary: The single highest value item per gram carried. Practise on a dead tyre at home before you need it on a shoulder.

spec.v: A plug is a repair to get you home

gear.name: Reflective vest, class rated
gear.summary: We have not run a controlled comparison. Any rated vest beats none, and the one you actually wear beats the better one you leave at home.
